title: Text: DET Tom Moore ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Hi Anthony! Is now a good time to chat or would you rather catch up tomorrow?
Thanks for getting back to me. I’m trying to get a quick workout in, what’s a good time to try you tomorrow?
I’m very impressed. Be careful, texting and working out can be more dangerous than texting and driving - speaking from experience 😂 Anytime in the morning should be fine.
I gotta hear about this story lol...Ok, I will call you at 11 after I leave the field
No story per se... just moments that make you realize multi-tasking on a treadmill is not the smartest thing to do. Sounds good. Talk to you tomorrow.
For sure...no treadmill today. I’ve knocked my phone off my headphones many times though. Do you run?
I try to. It’s usually the most efficient way for me to “try” to stay in shape while traveling.
I really like running, did a few half marathons but I lost it late 2016. Gotta get back in the groove this spring
